teaser: How many rooms have you left before the goodbyes finished? Life path 5 is the number of motion, and you carry it as an ISFP, someone who feels a room in color before deciding whether to stay in it. The pairing is not restlessness layered on restlessness — it is a hunger for the next real thing, met by a nature that only trusts what it has actually touched, tasted, or made. What results is a life that looks improvised and is actually paying very close attention. What gets harder to explain is why the exits always seem to come right when something was starting to matter.
excerpt: Someone leaves a window open and the whole apartment smells like rain before either of you says anything about it.
